annotations.title: Score unscored brand topics for display

description: Score an owned brand's topics that have no score yet, for display only, and return the job ID. Scores and their breakdown are stored for the property the Topic Bank shows (the brand's primary property, else its newest active one). This sets no decision band, so it never changes which topics can be generated or run on autopilot. A topic that already has a score is not rescored, except a display-only score saved without search data (for example after a failed keyword lookup), which is redone after the topics with no score. Rejected and expired topics are never scored; the rest are taken selected, then suggested, then converted, newest first within each. Optional topic_ids (at most 200) limits the set; a named rejected or expired topic is skipped and counted in left_out. Keyword data for each topic uses the organization's search research allowance, and each call is bounded by a daily per-organization scoring limit shared with the scoring that follows topic creation; both are checked before any job starts. Returns outcome, job_id (null when nothing started), unscored, accepted and left_out: topics past the limit stay unscored and are counted in left_out. A request while one is running for the brand returns that job. Does not accept an idempotency key. Poll GET /jobs/{job_id} with the returned job ID. Rescoring topics that already have a score, which sets decision bands, is a separate operation.

body.description:
Score a brand's topics that have no score yet, for display only.

A display-only score saved without search data (for example after a
failed keyword lookup) also counts as unscored and is redone, after the
never-scored topics. Rejected and expired topics are never scored. Omit
``topic_ids`` for the brand's unscored topics, filled selected, then
suggested, then converted (newest first within each); give them to limit
the run. Ids that are not the brand's, or that have any other score, are
ignored; a named rejected or expired topic is skipped and counted in
``left_out``. Sets no decision band.
body.title: PublicScoreUnscoredTopicsRequest

name: score_unscored_topics

anyOf.description:
What a score-unscored request did.

``unscored`` topics had no score for ``property_id`` (the property the
Topic Bank shows), or only a display-only score without search data;
``accepted`` of them are scored by ``job_id`` (poll
``GET /jobs/{job_id}``); ``left_out`` stay unscored because of the daily
scoring limit, the per-run cap, a refused start, or because they are named
rejected or expired topics. ``job_id`` is null
when ``outcome`` started nothing.

outcome.description:
What a "score unscored topics" request did.

``STARTED`` and ``ALREADY_RUNNING`` carry a job to follow. The others start
nothing: no unscored topic, no property to score against, the
organization's daily scoring limit or search allowance is used up, or the
daily-limit store is unavailable (refused rather than unbounded).
